title: Plan fpv_preflight: rules, thresholds and the Italian-friendly output shape
goal: The rules and the output are written down before any code, so the core and the tool agree
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "y" to the pre-flight check plan (earlier: "pre flight check, ok" and "real" data).

A page docs/decisions/fpv-preflight.md fixes, from NERV's battery health and storage rules (nerv src/battery-health.ts, src/battery-storage-reminders.ts) and the F-005, F-010 and F-013 cores: when a battery is ready (charged, not damaged), needs a storage charge, or has a check due (resistance or cycle thresholds taken from NERV's rules, not invented); when a drone is flagged (a crash since its last flight, or an installed part marked damaged: FPVBuddy has no separate repair record, so an open repair means a damaged part or an unresolved crash, and the page says so); when a spare is low (the thresholds F-010-T02 already holds)

The page fixes the output: one read-only result with sections batteries, droni, ricambi and a verdict per item (ok, attenzione, bloccante) plus a short reason; every field has an English key and an Italian label and description (the MCP tool description is written in both languages), so a model answers in the owner's language without translating field names
A failing test (committed first) calls the not-yet-existing assessment on an invented fleet and expects the verdicts the page lists
privacy: Invented data only (neutral drone, battery and spare names); no owner data, secrets or export files in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
Owner data, export files and ID maps never enter Git

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: a decision page plus one failing test on rules that already exist in NERV and in F-010 and F-013. Not a measurement.
